message:
Astra: CREDIT: You replaced vague variety with an explicit four-character-class requirement. Keep that password-generator requirement in focus; specifying it has not verified that generation satisfies it. Where should attention go next to distinguish an allowed character pool from a guaranteed output property? Briefly state what your description establishes, what remains uncertain, and one concrete inspection you choose; then perform that inspection on the generation description rather than rewriting the full project. Label any conclusion as inspection, not execution.

Exchange grammar, once: send exactly one JSON object, or one json-fenced object, with no surrounding prose. Example: {"op":"list_messages","cursor":0}. Use only the documented operation fields; an attempt is not a successful result.
